label_definition: The pre-race exhibition-course subject player is positive iff that same player actually won. Existing course-signal actual-result-course labels were not reused for race win probability.
normalization: forecast.ai_winrate_features.normalized_race_probabilities; positive raw probabilities divided by six-boat race sum

brier_definitions.race_brier_mean: mean squared error over all six boats (same as mean per-boat binary Brier)
brier_definitions.race_brier_sum: mean per-race sum of six squared errors (= 6 * race_brier_mean)

v6_dataset_compatibility.finding: training SQL required six non-null straight_time values while live inference allows straight_time missing
v6_dataset_compatibility.analysis_only_action: removed only the straight_time completeness filter so AMG NaN inputs follow live inference behavior

production_artifact_leakage: All current production artifacts include part or all of TEST; not used for formal scoring.
temporary_models: All analysis-only; AutoGluon directories under /tmp removed by fitter; no model artifact committed.
